Daily Devotional

May 10

8 A double minded man is unstable in all his ways. (James 1:8 KJV)

A double minded man is one that is thinking two different things at the same time. It is talking about a person who is believing (having faith), and not believing (having doubt,) at the same time. Having faith and unbelief at the same time is very possible, and that is why Jesus told the ruler of the synagogue to believe only (Luke 8:50), and that we should not doubt (Mark 11:23).

The unbelief that a person has can negate the faith he has, and stand in the way of receiving the healing or blessing from the Lord. In order to get our prayers answered, we need to be sure and believe only, and not have the unbelief in our hearts that comes from this world, and the prince thereof. It is written that we must believe when we pray (Matthew 21:22), that we will receive what we are praying for, to be able to see our prayers come to pass. A double minded man doesn’t have a chance to receive from the Lord. We need to all keep single minded upon the things of God (Isaiah 26:3), and we will not ever be double minded, but will rest in the peace of God. Thank you Lord for the bible, our operating manual.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
